description: Source code for multiplayer UI and network handling in the Battle for Wesnoth game, including classes for chat, UI layout, network communication, and game state management.

classes.name: chat
classes.description: Handles chat message history, formatting, and textbox initialization and updates.

classes.name: ui
classes.description: Manages multiplayer lobby UI, network communication, event handling, and layout.

methods.name: check_response
methods.description: Checks network response and throws errors if connection times out or error message received.

methods.name: level_to_gamestate
methods.description: Converts level configuration data to game state, handling replay data and campaign type.

methods.name: get_colour_string
methods.description: Returns a string representing a color based on an ID.

methods.name: chat::add_message
methods.description: Adds a message to chat history, maintaining a maximum size.

methods.name: chat::init_textbox
methods.description: Initializes a textbox with the current chat message history.

methods.name: chat::update_textbox
methods.description: Updates a textbox with new chat messages since last update.

methods.name: chat::format_message
methods.description: Formats a chat message for display.

methods.name: ui::process_network
methods.description: Handles incoming network data and new connections.

methods.name: ui::get_result
methods.description: Returns the current UI result state.

methods.name: ui::set_result
methods.description: Sets the UI result state.

methods.name: ui::xscale
methods.description: Calculates scaled x coordinate based on display width.

methods.name: ui::yscale
methods.description: Calculates scaled y coordinate based on display height.

methods.name: ui::client_area
methods.description: Returns the client area rectangle for the UI.

methods.name: ui::draw_contents
methods.description: Draws the lobby background and UI elements.

methods.name: ui::set_location
methods.description: Sets UI location and initializes chat textbox.

methods.name: ui::handle_event
methods.description: Handles SDL events, delegating to specific handlers.

methods.name: ui::handle_key_event
methods.description: Handles key events, including sending chat messages.

methods.name: ui::process_network_data
methods.description: Processes incoming network data, including messages and gamelist updates.

methods.name: ui::process_network_error
methods.description: Handles network errors, logs and rethrows.

methods.name: ui::process_network_connection
methods.description: Handles new network connections.

methods.name: ui::hide_children
methods.description: Hides or shows UI child widgets.

methods.name: ui::layout_children
methods.description: Arranges UI child widgets within the given rectangle.

methods.name: ui::gamelist_updated
methods.description: Updates the user list based on gamelist data.

methods.name: ui::set_user_list
methods.description: Sets the user list and plays sounds on changes.

methods.name: ui::title
methods.description: Returns the title widget.
